name: layout
description: Foundations contract for the layout & spacing system: containers, section layouts, section rhythm, and content grids. UIDS owns the vocabulary (spacing scale, gutters, breakpoints, container caps); uids_base (SiteNow) is the downstream consumer whose Layout Builder classes express these patterns. Not a component — no Vue code, no Figma component set.

figma.note: Documentation page (container frames + layout grids), not a component set. space/* and layout/* variables live in the Primitives and Semantic collections.

options.name: container
options.description: Section container behavior: outer width and page margin. Standard: 1.25rem side margins, caps/centers at 81.875em from the page-container breakpoint. Narrow: caps at 63.75em from md. Wide: caps at 100em with 1.875rem side padding at page-container. Full: viewport-wide with 1.25rem/3rem margins. Edge: no outer margins.

code.notes: standard's visual behavior is largely the default container mixin; the modifier class adds little

options.name: layout
options.description: Section column structure. Mobile-first: every multi-column layout stacks below md (980px), then adopts its ratio. Ratios are authored patterns, not a universal 12-column grid.

code.notes: class families live in uids_base scss/layouts/; 50/50 and 33/34/33 consume the shared UIDS grid mixins

options.name: contentGrid
options.description: Modular grid for repeated content (cards, lists, feeds) inside a region. Activation is gated by parent region width (inner-grid mixin: twocol needs parent >= 50%, threecol/fourcol >= 75%).

options.name: sectionPaddingRemovedTop
options.description: Layout Builder: Remove top spacing (top padding 0)

options.name: sectionPaddingRemovedBottom
options.description: Layout Builder: Remove bottom spacing (bottom padding 0)

options.name: sectionPaddingTopExtra
options.description: Layout Builder: Add extra top spacing (top padding = layout/section/padding/extra)

options.name: sectionPaddingBottomExtra
options.description: Layout Builder: Add extra bottom spacing (bottom padding = layout/section/padding/extra)

options.name: sectionPaddingTopRestored
options.description: Layout Builder: Restore default spacing — TOP EDGE ONLY (see knownIssues)

options.name: columnSpacingRemoved
options.description: Layout Builder: Remove default column spacing (region gaps and stacked-region spacing)

options.name: sectionOrderReversed
options.description: Layout Builder: Reverse column order on mobile

geometryNotTokenized.sidebar-ratio: 24.25% sidebar / 72.75% content, separated by 3% right margin on the sidebar (md+); content 100% when sidebar hidden
geometryNotTokenized.grid-minmax: content-grid tracks: twocol minmax(46.7%, 1fr), threecol minmax(29.74%, 1fr), fourcol minmax(21%, 1fr) — auto-fill
geometryNotTokenized.inner-grid-breakpoint: 58.125em (930px) internal breakpoint in _grid-mixins.scss for three/four-col inner grids and twocol's fixed 1fr 1fr switch — NOT one of the tokenized breakpoints
geometryNotTokenized.onecol-fixed-padding: 1.1rem top/bottom (space/110), a condensed band outside the section rhythm
geometryNotTokenized.twocol-25-75-gaps: 1.5rem gap at sm -> 3rem at page-container (only content grid whose gap steps at page-container)
geometryNotTokenized.block-margin-utilities: 1.05rem base (space/105), --extra variants step to 2rem at sm; __right/__left have no mobile value
geometryNotTokenized.strays: 0.2rem and 1.75rem appear once each in uids_base layouts; left raw deliberately

behavior: Mobile-first: all multi-column layouts stack below md (980px); stacked regions use layout/gutter/height/mobile (2rem) bottom spacing
Section rhythm steps at sm (768px), NOT md: padding goes 1.25rem -> 3rem top/bottom; the first section removes top padding
Adjacent sections with the same background treatment (none/gold/black/gray/brain variants) merge: the second removes its top padding

Block stacking: sibling blocks in Layout Builder regions get 1.6rem top spacing (layout/block/stack/default); .block-margin__top reduces to 1.05rem, __top--extra becomes 2rem from sm, __default--removed zeroes it — the margin utilities are authored overrides on the default rhythm, not purely additive
Containers cap/center at the page-container breakpoint (1350px): standard 81.875em, wide 100em + 1.875rem side padding; narrow caps earlier (md, 63.75em)
Content grids: non-grid lists stack at 2rem; grid gaps are 2rem mobile -> 3rem from sm (desktop gutter)
knownIssues: section-padding__top-restored restores the TOP edge only; there is no bottom-restore class
The word 'md' means two different things in 4.x SCSS: $md = 1.05rem (a spacing value) vs $break-md / --space-md-width-gutter (breakpoint / 2rem). The space.* scale supersedes the spacing sense.
grid--twocol--50-50 column-gap uses var(--space-lg-width-gutter) while threecol/fourcol use $desktop-width-gutter — same 3rem value via two mechanisms (compile-time vs runtime)
